Name: Ridgeside Torts Cat Replacer
Author: EchosBento
Description:
This is a Content Patcher mod to replace the cat Marnie gives you with the tortoise added in Ridgeside Village's 2.0 update. The config allows you to select which cat the mod replaces; Orange, Grey, or Tan.

For Adopt 'n' Skin users there is an additional file providing the sprite sheet. Simply place the AdoptSkin folder into your mods directory.

Check out the original Ridgeside Village mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]here[/url].
